locationsBody: Live Crossbones Isle names from Fortnite-API. Editorial contest / loot tips sit on the major named drops below.
hotBody: The $.$. Rocky (Boss ship), Arlong Park, Loguetown, Fortune’s Fort (week-2 Lil Uzi fort after 8 Nov).

landingTitle: Best Fortnite landing spots by goal
landingFightBody: Drop contested named locations under the bus path. You will die more often, but you learn loot speed, first fights, and third-party timing faster.
landingRankedBody: Prefer balanced or edge POIs, leave with mobility, and rotate early. Surviving to top 10 usually beats greed-looting one more chest.
landingSquadsBody: Land in the same building cluster, split floors, and meet on a marked point. Split-landing across a whole city creates free 1v3s.

faqs.q1: What is the current Fortnite map in Treasure Hunters?
faqs.a1: Treasure Hunters (v43.00) uses Crossbones Isle, an 80-player Battle Royale island. Live Fortnite-API names include Arlong Park, Fortune’s Fort, Rubber Resort, Loguetown, Lantern Landing, The $.$. Rocky, and more. This tool’s pins follow that dump.
faqs.q2: Where is the Pirate Shop on the Fortnite map?
faqs.a2: It is not a map pin. Pirate Shop Access is a rare Battle Royale chest prize. Open chests, watch for the unlock MOTD, then claim Item Shop rows during the 14-day windows.
faqs.q3: Where should I land in Fortnite for the best loot?
faqs.a3: Hot names: The $.$. Rocky, Arlong Park, Loguetown, and Fortune’s Fort after the 8 Nov Captain’s Day. Balanced: Rubber Resort, Windmill Village, Plunder Port. Filter hot / balanced / edge on this map, then trust in-game labels if anything disagrees.
faqs.q4: How do I use this interactive Fortnite map?
faqs.a4: Use the left sidebar: pick Battle Royale, search spawns/POIs, toggle spawn layers (NPCs, vaults, Sprite chests, chests, vehicles, reboot vans, and more), Named Locations / Landmarks, then filter drops by hot / balanced / edge. Click markers for tips. Spawn pins are POI-anchored planning markers. OG, Reload, and Blitz maps are still coming soon.
faqs.q5: Does this Fortnite map update every season?
faqs.a5: Yes. The minimap image and coordinates load from live Fortnite-API data, so named locations refresh when that dump updates. Editorial loot tips are reviewed around major patches — last Crossbones Isle pass 7 Nov 2026.
